target.name: Steam Prey.exe / PreyDll.dll with PreyVR backdrop 9b38d02

question: Does the separately captured PDA contain alpha that reveals a background through its interior?
claim: Yes: magenta appears through the item grid and description in both simulated eyes; disabling separate capture leaves only a border, and re-enabling restores the interior effect.
method: Unmodified branch 9b38d025b865e67d56b0a7ce097c087163321f1a; xr-sim D3D11 image capture and xr-tape 0.1.0. Launch with tools/Invoke-PreyVRLaunch.ps1 and process-scoped runtime; vr.enable; native menu taps to load existing save and open inventory; ui.inventory 1; ui.backdrop 1; shot inventory_magenta; ui.inventory 0; shot inventory_opaque_control; ui.inventory 1; shot inventory_magenta_repeat. See report for exact run/build, same-display-time tape correlation and pixel control.

identity.reason: DLL hash recorded at launch; retail module hash measured; PID 89128 and trace header agree.

instrument.reason: Both-eye images and same-display-time xr-tape end result 0; nontruncated trace.

control.reason: Opaque panel with backdrop gives border only; re-enabled separate inventory gives magenta interior again.

scene.reason: Existing Talos Lobby save, Items inventory with Disruptor selected visible in both eye captures.

restore.reason: Backdrop and inventory capture disabled, vr.disable logged teardown, owned Prey process closed and no Prey remained.

baseline.reason: Release build and 39/39 tests passed; requested inventory sequence completed; no xrEndFrame errors in 18281 recorded frames. This is not full headset acceptance.

limits: Quad fallback on simulated Quest optics; no real headset or cylinder validation. Alpha exists in the tested PDA interior, not necessarily everywhere. No world render or world re-entry implemented. Counters alone are not alpha or successful submission proof.
next_action: Render or retain gameplay world behind the existing alpha inventory. Queue as a Prey UI compositing finding; world-render safety and headset contrast are separate acceptance steps.
